descriptionChirho: The proper name of the first human being created by God, used in NT genealogies (Luke 3:38), typological contrasts with Christ (Romans 5:14, 1 Corinthians 15:22, 15:45), references to the creation order (1 Timothy 2:13-14), and Jude's genealogical note (Jude 14). All translations consistently transliterate the Hebrew name: Spanish Adám, Arabic آدَمُ (Adam), Korean 아담 (Adam), Hindi आदम (Adam), Swahili Adamu. The two clusters differ only in grammatical case distribution — S61282 covers nominative, dative, and genitive singular forms (8x), while S61283 is a single genitive occurrence — with identical meaning throughout.
